name: Encoding

match.coverage: Invariant documentation and Echidna property tests only; not a manual security review. Several documented properties are marked Not Tested.

lines.text: * @notice RLP encodes the L2 transaction that would be generated when a given deposit is sent
*         to the L2 system. Useful for searching for a deposit in the L2 system.
*         This currently only supports user deposits and not system
*         to the L2 system. Useful for searching for a deposit in the L2 system. The
*         transaction is prefixed with 0x7e to identify its EIP-2718 type.
